# Sample size calculation for proportion confidence interval using normal approximation
# Formula: n = (z_alpha/2)^2 * p(1-p) / ME^2
# where ME is the margin of error (half-width of CI)

# Parameters
p <- 0.70                    # target proportion
ME <- 0.03                   # half-width (margin of error)
alpha <- 0.05                # significance level for two-sided 95% CI
confidence_level <- 0.95

# Get exact standard normal 97.5th percentile (for two-sided alpha=0.05, use alpha/2=0.025)
z_critical <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

# Calculate required sample size
n_exact <- (z_critical^2 * p * (1 - p)) / (ME^2)

# Round upward to next integer
n_rounded <- ceiling(n_exact)

# Display results
cat("Standard normal 97.5th percentile (z_{0.975}):", z_critical, "\n")
cat("Target proportion (p):", p, "\n")
cat("Margin of error (half-width):", ME, "\n")
cat("Exact sample size (before rounding):", n_exact, "\n")
cat("Sample size (rounded upward):", n_rounded, "\n")

# Verify the margin of error achieved with the rounded sample size
ME_achieved <- z_critical * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_rounded)
cat("\nVerification - margin of error achieved with n =", n_rounded, ":", 
    format(ME_achieved, digits = 6), "\n")

# Output for structured reporting
result_list <- list(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_rounded,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

library(jsonlite)
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", toJSON(list(results = list(result_list)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n", sep = "")
